basis: experimental design and data access ONLY; NOT any imagery-reliability value

rationale.D1: matched perception (test images) + imagery of the SAME identities, 20 imagery runs across 3-4 sessions, repeated category identities (~10/category), fully public (OpenNeuro CC0 + figshare), official visual ROIs (V1-V4, VC). Best match to the static perception<->imagery geometry question. FIRST empirical qualification target.
rationale.D2: public and rich, but imagery is RECALL of dynamic VIDEO with verbal preparation cues (semantic/cue confound); paradigm not directly comparable to static-image geometry. Evaluated ONLY if D1 prospectively fails.
rationale.D3: scientifically strong for topographic geometry (7T, pRF, K=4 high-rep) but not located on OpenNeuro and access likely requires an author request; K=4 cannot justify broad natural-image claims. Not acquired in this gate.

conditional_rule: inspect D2 neural outcomes ONLY if D1 does not reach DATASET_RELIABILITY_PASS; never to pick whichever dataset looks better (dataset-level outcome fishing forbidden).
